_meta.source: C2 (M6a) common-reporting-limit sensitivity: PFOS detections below the coarser UCMR3 reporting limit (0.04 ug/L; UCMR5 is ~0.004) are re-censored to non-detect, the T1 label rebuilt, and XGBoost retrained on the same assembly. Reproduction gate ties the un-recensored baseline to the frozen T1 headline within 0.02.

interpretation: A small AUROC shift means the pooled detection signal is robust to reporting-limit heterogeneity; a large shift would mean detection-limit differences drive part of the apparent T1 performance.
